newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - Chartists mixed on Bel-20 outlook.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Chartists mixed on Bel-20 outlook.

text.p: Chartists have mixed views on the trend of the Bel-20 index, with some pointing to a resumed rally, others to a brief climb followed by a decline, and others still suggesting a pause and possible dip.

Either way, Kredietbank and Petrofina were among those likely to outperform the market as their weighting in the index is due to be raised on September 20, while UCB and Bekaert were seen likely to fall further due to their weighting being reduced.
The Bel-20 ended at 1,735.62 on Friday, having staged a mild recovery from its 1,714.31 close on August 30.

CERA - Belgian stocks haven't risen yet amid concern U.S. interest rates are set to rise. The good results of CBR and Delhaize could break the sentiment and bring the Bel-20 above the first resistance of 1,750. Attention will be also focused on Tractebel after recent reports that Societe Generale de Belgique is to buy the 20.3 percent stake in Tractebel from GBL. In our opinion, stocks that will have their weighting increased in the index (e.g. Kredietbank and Petrofina), which takes effect September 20, will outperform the market in coming days.

BANK DEGROOF - The market is now flagging and we have to admit that the present correction still has upward potential even if our longer term view still remains bearish. The 1,710 level is a crucial support to break to see the lows. On the other hand the index will face a lot of intermediate resistances (1,737-40-43-51-62) before we can talk about the last highs.

ECOFIS - The harami cross of last Monday initiated a pause and small turnaround. But the hanging man of last Friday suggests topping below 1,740. The weekly chart displays a harami, possibly meaning at least a pause across the 50 percent lower half of the long black candle of two weeks ago. The "relief rally" -- relief in the sense that the jobs report was not stronger than expected -- in the Dow last Friday is likely to be reassessed. That too might weigh on the Bel-20.

GENERALE BANK - The 1,710 support level was strengthened through the successful testing, while some intermediate support lays around 1,680. Only a loss of the support level around 1,630-1,650 would seriously affect the potential of further upward moves. On the upside first resistance stands at 1,745, while the market seems seriously capped at 1,785 for the time being. The upward movement of the market was realised on small volume, so a pick up in turnover is needed as a confirmation before successfully attacking resistance levels.
